name: javacv
reason: FFmpegFrameGrabber is a JNI wrapper; MP3 frame parsing and decoding run in native FFmpeg (libavformat/libavcodec), so there are no Java parser source lines for JaCoCo. The C/FFmpeg family belongs to a native cell. Recorded as FFmpeg family in data/java/mp3_id3v2/parsers.json.

name: ffmpeg
reason: JavaCPP binding to the same native FFmpeg demuxer and decoder as javacv; no Java parser source. Not run.

name: jave-core
reason: Runs a bundled ffmpeg executable and parses its text output; parser is native FFmpeg. Not run.

name: jlayer
reason: libGDX repackaging of JLayer; same decoder family as javazoom:jlayer. Not run.

name: jlayer
reason: Maintained fork of javazoom JLayer; same decoder family as javazoom:jlayer. Not run.

name: korau-mp3
reason: Kotlin korau MP3 decoder module published to Maven (last release 0.19.1); decoder lineage not inspected. Control not run.

name: javamp3
reason: MIT-licensed pure-Java Sound(BufferedInputStream) decoder 1.0.1 has no JLayer runtime dependency. In the pinned Docker valid-control probe it decodes the 44.1 kHz mono control to the oracle's 12,672 samples, but Sound construction on the valid 22.05 kHz stereo control throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException at Decoder.samples_III(Decoder.java:773). It cannot meet the two-control verification gate; no JaCoCo or AFL claim is made.

name: jaffree
reason: Drives an external ffprobe/ffmpeg process; parser is native FFmpeg. Not run.

name: basicplayer
reason: Player UI over mp3spi/JLayer; no parser of its own; zero direct dependents.

name: jlayer
reason: Modularized JLayer repackaging; zero deps.dev direct dependents. Same JLayer family. Not run.

name: mp3spi
reason: Modularized MP3SPI repackaging over dev.mccue:jlayer; zero direct dependents. Same JLayer family. Not run.

name: mp3-wav
reason: MP3-to-WAV converter; zero direct dependents; decoder backend not inspected. Not run.
